risks.risk: Lens focal length/model may not be 18-55mm (could be different Canon zoom or a non-matching lens).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the lens barrel text showing the exact focal length range (e.g., '18-55mm') and lens model name/number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used Canon DSLR body with an unconfirmed/possibly non-18-55 kit lens (worst case: treat lens as generic/less valuable).

risks.risk: Shutter count / usage level unknown; could be high wear.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo from the camera menu showing shutter count (or a service/EXIF tool readout).

risks.risk: Sensor condition (dust, fungus, scratches) and image quality unknown.
risks.proof: A test shot of a blank wall at f/16 (or f/22) plus a close-up photo of the sensor area (mirror up) if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if sensor may need cleaning (worst case: assume dust/fungus risk).

risks.risk: Functionality unknown (AF, buttons, ports, autofocus accuracy, battery/charger health).
risks.proof: Short video or photo sequence showing autofocus lock on a subject + playback of images; also show charging/USB/ports working if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed (worst case: assume possible minor faults until tested).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, strap, memory card) not shown.
risks.proof: A single photo laying out all included items (battery, charger, cables, strap, lens caps, hood, manual, memory card).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only the camera body + lens are included (worst case: missing key accessories).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the lens barrel showing the exact '18-55mm' text and lens model.
Photo/screenshot of shutter count from the camera or a shutter-count tool.
Test images: one at f/16 of a plain surface to check sensor dust + one normal shot showing autofocus.
Photo of all included accessories laid out (battery, charger, lens caps/hood, strap, memory card).
Close-up of the sensor area (mirror up) or a sensor-cleaning check.
response.reason: The photos confirm the Canon EOS 800D body, but the key pricing drivers for a used deal—exact lens (18-55mm confirmation), shutter count, sensor condition, and included accessories—are not verifiable from the provided images.
